## MSADrawOptions.zoomAxes property

Axes that Ctrl/⌘-scroll (and trackpad pinch) zoom. `"columns"` keeps rows at a readable height while zooming along the sequence. A plain scroll always pans.

**Signature:**

```typescript
zoomAxes?: "both" | "columns";
```

## Default Value

"both"
